description: XDR Network Analytics — DNS/Proxy/Firewall. Shadow-only advisory analytics. No blocking or containment.
title: XDR Network Analytics

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, COUNT(*) AS value FROM dns_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY date_trunc('minute', created_at) ORDER BY time
SELECT created_at AS time, COUNT(*) AS value FROM proxy_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY date_trunc('minute', created_at) ORDER BY time
SELECT created_at AS time, action AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM firewall_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY date_trunc('minute', created_at), action ORDER BY time

SELECT queried_domain, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_nxdomain THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nxdomain_count FROM dns_events WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY queried_domain ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT destination_ip, COUNT(*) AS flow_count, SUM(bytes_out) AS total_bytes_out FROM firewall_events WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND destination_ip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY destination_ip ORDER BY flow_count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT created_at AS time, host_id AS metric, SUM(bytes_out) AS value FROM proxy_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND bytes_out > 1048576 GROUP BY date_trunc('minute', created_at), host_id ORDER BY time
SELECT finding_type, source_domain, host_id, severity, created_at FROM network_behavioral_findings WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT last_seen_at AS time, destination_key AS metric, contact_count AS value FROM network_destination_profiles WHERE is_rare = true AND $__timeFilter(last_seen_at) ORDER BY time
